results.text: {"General": "A mystical white fox-girl with glowing red eyes walks gracefully across a grassy field dotted with small white flowers. The background features a large, blurry floating island and a tall clock tower showing about 11:05, set against a softly lit sky at dawn or dusk. The scene is dreamy and serene, with soft focus and depth of field emphasizing the fox-girl in the foreground.", "Character 1": "A slender, white-furred fox-girl with long, pointed ears tipped with pinkish inner fur and small black markings. Her fur is fluffy and dotted with subtle glowing sparkles, especially along her back and tail. She has bright red eyes that glow softly, giving her an ethereal look. Her bushy tail flows behind her as she walks on all fours with a calm, curious expression, gazing slightly upward and to the left.", "Background Objects": "A tall clock tower stands prominently to the right, its clock face clearly visible showing a time close to 11:05. In the distance, a large, blurry floating island hovers above the landscape, contributing to the fantasy atmosphere. The grassy field is sprinkled with small white flowers and scattered rocks, enhancing the natural setting."}

{"General": "The image is a digital composite showing a 3x4 grid of nine head-and-shoulders portraits of older men in formal suits, set against a blurred background of a crowded soccer stadium at night. Each portrait is framed with a dark blue border and numbered 1 to 9 in the top left corner. Below each portrait is a white nameplate with black text displaying the name of each FIFA 19 manager. Above the grid, bold white text reads 'Top FIFA 19 Management codis.' The overall style is realistic, with sharp focus on the faces and a soft bokeh effect on the stadium crowd and field behind.", "Character 1": "Honsa Lrkra, a man with short brown hair, a neatly trimmed gray beard, and a warm, friendly smile. He wears a dark suit jacket, white shirt, and blue tie. His head is slightly tilted forward, looking directly at the viewer.", "Character 2": "Pichis Lrura, an older man with short gray hair and a mustache. He has a serious, neutral expression and wears a dark suit with a white shirt and blue tie.", "Character 3": "Fiesen Cuna, an older man with short gray hair, a full beard, and a slightly stern expression. He wears a dark suit, white shirt, and blue tie.", "Character 4": "Duna Ecina, an older man with short gray hair and a mustache, smiling gently. He wears a dark suit, white shirt, and a purple tie.", "Character 5": "Nonano Erura, a man with short brown hair and a mustache, smiling warmly. He wears a dark suit, white shirt, and purple tie.", "Character 6": "Morram Frika, a man with short gray hair and a full beard, showing a neutral or slightly serious expression. He wears a dark suit, white shirt, and blue tie.", "Character 7": "Hamin Esira, an older man with short gray hair and a mustache, smiling gently. He wears a dark suit, white shirt, and blue tie.", "Character 8": "Bisin Erura, a man with short brown hair and a mustache, smiling warmly. He wears a dark suit, white shirt, and blue tie.", "Character 9": "Cooin Frika, an older man with short gray hair and a mustache, smiling gently. He wears a dark suit, white shirt, and blue tie."}

{"General": "Three armed girls stand in a ruined urban battlefield under a cloudy sky, surrounded by rubble, debris, and broken buildings. The scene is tense and gritty, with a smoky, war-torn cityscape featuring neon signs and a damaged police car with flashing lights. The atmosphere is somber and foreboding, emphasizing the aftermath of conflict.", "Character 1": "A girl with long, flowing blue hair and sharp yellow eyes wears a dark blue beret with a badge, a cropped dark blue jacket with rolled-up sleeves, a white shirt, and dark blue tactical pants. She has black fingerless gloves, a black choker, and a utility belt with pouches and a thigh holster. She holds a black assault rifle equipped with a scope and suppressor, gripping it firmly with both hands, standing confidently and alert.", "Character 2": "A girl with long brown hair tied in a ponytail wears a dark blue jacket over a white shirt, a short pleated black skirt, and black thigh-high stockings with boots. She wears black fingerless gloves and a utility belt with pouches. Holding a black assault rifle with a scope in a ready stance, her focused expression and slight forward lean indicate readiness for action.", "Character 3": "A girl with medium-length brown hair tied in a ponytail wears a dark blue jacket and black skirt, black gloves, and tactical gear including a utility belt and thigh holster. She holds a black assault rifle with a scope, standing slightly behind the others with a serious, focused expression, scanning the surroundings for threats."}

{"General": "Seven characters stand on a lush green floating island under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds. In the background, several other floating islands with castles and towers are connected by glowing magical lines. The scene is vibrant and detailed, with clear anime-style art emphasizing a fantasy adventure setting. A small red dragon with black horns and big eyes sits near the characters, adding a whimsical touch.", "Character 1": "A muscular bearded man with short spiked brown hair and a scar across his nose and face. He wears dark brown leather armor with silver shoulder plates, fingerless gloves, and a utility belt with pouches and a blue vial. He stands confidently at the center with clenched fists and a serious expression.", "Character 2": "A young man with short dark blue hair and a calm, focused expression. He wears silver armor with a dark blue tunic underneath and holds a sword in his right hand, standing in a relaxed but ready pose.", "Character 3": "A blonde girl with short hair tied in a small ponytail, wearing a white and green outfit with a short skirt, black arm warmers, and brown boots. She smiles brightly and stands with one hand on her hip, radiating cheerful energy.", "Character 4": "A tall woman with long dark purple hair and a serious demeanor. She wears a dark purple and white dress with a capelet and thigh-high stockings, standing with arms crossed.", "Character 5": "A tall blonde woman with long flowing hair and a confident smile. She wears a blue and white armored dress with thigh-high boots and a cape, holding a sword sheathed at her side.", "Character 6": "A slender woman with long aqua hair styled in a side ponytail. She wears a white and blue dress with gold accents and a flowing cape, standing gracefully with a gentle expression.", "Character 7": "A green-haired elf woman with pointed ears and a calm smile. She wears a green dress with gold accents and stands with arms relaxed at her sides.", "Creature": "A small red dragon with large round eyes, black horns, and a yellow underbelly sits near the group, looking friendly and playful."}
